notes: dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with reviewed port-count mixes, rated-power trajectories and CAD2022 equipment/installation costs per port. legacy_charging_profiles: Ontario RAMP-mobility BEV simulations (2018 Toronto calendar; seed 42), corrected for charging-loss/SOC accounting and UTC weather alignment. Inputs combine survey driving patterns, Ontario driver/vehicle shares, legacy sales-weighted battery capacities, population-weighted Renewables Ninja weather and inherited charger access/power. Embedded fleet/range/charger composition proxies shared LDV charging across selected regions; CANOE rescales hourly shapes to reviewed charger utilization.
  - tts_night: Ontario GGH TTS 2016 aggregate weekday travel, repeated on weekends because weekend observations are unavailable; legacy weekend activity probabilities retained. Night charging preferentially uses 22:00–07:00 Toronto time, spreading energy over eligible parked minutes. Low SOC/insufficient next-trip energy permits emergency charging outside preferred windows. Initial/target SOC 80%, charging efficiency 90%; 2,499 rounded drivers.
